items.title: Dan Barrett interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, you’d think Joe Smooth or somebody you know.

ctx.x: My cousin played trumpet, oh that’s nice. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
You know, you’d think Joe Smooth or somebody you know. Louis Armstrong. That may be enough about Louis even though not enough can be said.
I just want to ask you did you ever hear him in person?
